name: Andrew Sameh
summary: Personal blog and portfolio built on a shadcn/ui revamp of tailwind-nextjs-starter-blog, with resume and experience sections.
description: Open-source personal site: MDX blog with three post layouts, a projects page, a resume page and custom experience and technologies components. Wires up Contentlayer content, Giscus comments, newsletter, analytics and a kbar command palette; MIT licensed as a starter you clone and customize.
contains: Next.js, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui personal blog based on tailwind-nextjs-starter-blog
3 blog post layouts and 2 listing layouts, tags and multiple authors
projects page, resume page, custom experience and technologies components
Contentlayer MDX with KaTeX maths, citations and code highlighting
pliny integrations: analytics, Giscus comments, newsletter and kbar command palette
Prisma + MongoDB and Auth.js for a protected section (under development)
light and dark theme, 85kB first load
